metadata.name: Lucky Strip
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A casino boulevard at night, built from the Neon Megacity style pack. Casino-resort fronts line the Strip under neon signs and holographic billboards: the Crimson Ace behind its fountain lake (the lights put on a show every 40 seconds), the Silver Comet with its slot floor, cashier cage, vault behind team-only vault doors and a showroom stage, and its hotel tower up to the Sky Lounge. The Desert Orchid has a pool on its roof, the parking garage a helipad on its, and both towers glass elevators up the outside. Pedestrian bridges cross the Strip, service alleys run round the back, and a monorail beam loops round it all 12 m up, its trains shuttling along every side. Heist the cage and the vault, rescue the hostages from the stage, or fight casino against casino.

do.text: Lucky Strip. The monorail does not stop for anyone: stay on the platform.
Vault override! The vault doors are open for 15 seconds.
